findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_profile, get_pricing · Private data: get_company_summary, get_exchange_rate, list_acting_capacity, get_company_context, get_company_deadlines, get_company_obligations, validate_action, explain_compliance_error, search_companies, get_company_verification, get_company_authority, get_company_accounts, get_company_filing_history, revoke_fullmakt, get_pricing, get_credit_balance, redeem_issuance_token · Public sink: get_company_profile · Destructive: list_acting_capacity, check_authorization, validate_action, search_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_profile, get_pricing · Private data: get_company_summary, get_exchange_rate, list_acting_capacity, get_company_context, get_company_deadlines, get_company_obligations, validate_action, explain_compliance_error, search_companies, get_company_verification, get_company_authority, get_company_accounts, get_company_filing_history, revoke_fullmakt, get_pricing, get_credit_balance, redeem_issuance_token · Public sink: get_company_profile · Destructive: list_acting_capacity, check_authorization, validate_action, search_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
